mod.overview: Ultra Renegades -X- is built on stock Tribes scripts, not on Renegades or VX5. It gives every armor the same 1.3 health and ten weapon slots. It adds three twin-barrel weapons (Rage Blaster, Orion and Triton rifles) that alternate between two hidden guns, a Tribes Armory bolt gun, Hyper Bombs, a recall teleporter and a Ghost Pack. Most weapons hit for several times an armor's full health. Hand items follow the VX pattern: unlimited repair kits and mines, a Grenade air brake and a Beacon speed booster.
notes: Armor: light, medium, heavy and the female armors all have maxDamage 1.3 (stock: 0.66 / 1.0 / 1.32). Energy is 500 (heavy 110). $MaxWeapons is 10 for every armor.

Twin-weapon system: Rage Blaster, Orion, Triton and the Hyper Bombs launcher are shells with no projectile of their own. Mounting one also mounts two hidden copies in slots 6 and 7 and gives them the same ammo count. Each shot removes one round from the main ammo and fires slots 6 and 7 in turn, tracked per client in .hd. A shot is skipped while either hidden gun is still firing or reloading. Unmounting removes both hidden guns.
Twin-weapon ammo quirk: after each shot the script copies the remaining count to the hidden gun that is about to fire, but writes 0 instead when exactly one round is left.
New damage types $TritonDamageType 14, $OrionDamageType 15, $RageBDamageType 16 and $TribesDamageType 17 hit all armors at 1.5x.
Hand items are never consumed: Repair Kit (heals 0.99), Mine, Grenade and Beacon onUse do not remove the item. Armors may carry 99 of each.
Default spawn kit: Light Armor, Tribes Armory, Triton, Disc Launcher, Repair Kit, Beacon, Grenade, Hyper Bombs, Plasma Gun, Orion, Blaster, Repair Pack, Mine.

VX heritage: the Grenade-as-AirBrake and Beacon-as-Speed-Booster (a thrown Boost mine) come from Ultra Renegades VX. So do the TribesArm item and its TribesShell shield-bolt projectile (the same names VX5 Hunter uses for its Phase Shifter), the LiL-style mount offset on TribesArm, and a GrenadeShell that matches VX5's LiLFFBShell (mass 9, damage 150, kickback 300, SoundELFFire). No VX psionics, LiL weapons or VX turrets are present.
All new weapons share the shop heading "bWeaponary".

TribesAmmo.summary: Tribes Bolts: ammunition for the Tribes Armory.
notes: Light armor may carry 500.

TribesArm.summary: Tribes Armory: a fast-firing gun of shield-shaped energy bolts with a 7 m blast, using Tribes Bolts.
notes: Fires TribesShell (Tribes damage type, which all armors take at 1.5x) every 0.03 s plus a 0.03 s reload.
It uses the same item and projectile names as VX5 Hunter's Phase Shifter (there a 4 m blast).
Part of the default spawn kit.
TribesArm.source: item.cs TribesArm, TribesArmImage; baseProjData.cs TribesShell; ArmorData.cs

RageBlasterAmmo.summary: Blaster Energy: the shared ammunition pool for the Rage Blaster.
notes: Carry limit is 50000. The hidden barrels get their own RageBlaster1Ammo/RageBlaster2Ammo copies of this count.

RageBlaster1.summary: Hidden first barrel of the Rage Blaster, mounted in slot 6. It fires the Blaster2Bolt.
notes: Not shown in inventory or the weapon bar. Fired by RageBlasterImage::onFire on alternate shots.
Blaster2Bolt is RageB damage with slight aim deflection (0.009).

RageBlaster2.summary: Hidden second barrel of the Rage Blaster, mounted in slot 7. It fires the slightly slower, paint-shaped Blaster1Bolt.
notes: Not shown in inventory. Fired on the other alternate shots.
Blaster1Bolt is RageB damage, aim deflection 0.007.

RageBlaster.summary: Rage Blaster: a twin-barrel blaster whose bolts alternate between two hidden guns. Each bolt does several times an armor's health.
notes: Mounting it mounts RageBlaster1 and RageBlaster2 in slots 6 and 7. Each shot uses one Blaster Energy and triggers the next hidden barrel. See the mod notes for the twin-weapon rules.
RageB damage is taken at 1.5x by every armor.

OrionAmmo.summary: Orion Shells: the shared ammunition pool for the Orion Rifle.
notes: Carry limit is 50000.

Orion1.summary: Hidden first barrel of the Orion Rifle (slot 6), firing near-instant smoke-trailed bullets.
notes: Orion1Bullet: Orion damage type, muzzle velocity 12000. Not shown in inventory.

Orion2.summary: Hidden second barrel of the Orion Rifle (slot 7), firing near-instant laser-hit bullets.
notes: Orion2Bullet: Orion damage type, muzzle velocity 12000. Not shown in inventory.

Orion.summary: Orion Rifle: a twin-barrel hitscan-like rifle alternating two hidden guns. Each bullet hits for several times an armor's health.
notes: Mounting it mounts Orion1 and Orion2 in slots 6 and 7. Each shot uses one Orion Shell (see the mod notes for the twin-weapon rules).
Orion damage is taken at 1.5x by every armor. Part of the default spawn kit.

TritonAmmo.summary: Triton Shells: the shared ammunition pool for the Triton Rifle.
notes: Carry limit is 50000.

Triton1.summary: Hidden first barrel of the Triton Rifle (slot 6).
notes: Fires TritonBullet: Triton damage type, plasma-trail shape, muzzle velocity 22000. Not shown in inventory.

Triton2.summary: Hidden second barrel of the Triton Rifle (slot 7), firing the same TritonBullet with a mine-activation sound.
notes: Not shown in inventory.

Triton.summary: Triton Rifle: the fastest of the twin-barrel rifles, alternating two hidden guns that fire near-instant Triton bullets.
notes: Mounting it mounts Triton1 and Triton2 in slots 6 and 7. Each shot uses one Triton Shell (see the mod notes for the twin-weapon rules).
Triton damage is taken at 1.5x by every armor. Part of the default spawn kit.

GrenadeAmmo.summary: Bomb Ammo: the shared ammunition pool for the Hyper Bombs launcher (stock Grenade Ammo, renamed).
notes: The hidden launchers get Grenade1Ammo/Grenade2Ammo copies of this count.

GrenadeLauncher1.summary: Hidden first Hyper Bombs launcher (slot 6), firing GrenadeShell.
notes: GrenadeShell here is a heavy (mass 9), barely bouncing bomb doing very large shrapnel damage in a 15 m blast. It is far stronger than stock's grenade.
Not shown in inventory.

GrenadeLauncher2.summary: Hidden second Hyper Bombs launcher (slot 7), firing SmokeShell: the same heavy bomb with a mortar explosion and a smoke trail.
notes: SmokeShell matches GrenadeShell in damage and blast but uses mortarExp and an rsmoke trail.

GrenadeLauncher.summary: Hyper Bombs: the grenade launcher becomes a twin launcher that alternates two hidden tubes of heavy bombs, firing far faster than stock's.
notes: Unlike stock, GrenadeLauncherImage has no projectile; onMount mounts GrenadeLauncher1 and GrenadeLauncher2 in slots 6 and 7, and onFire alternates between them using one Bomb Ammo per shot.
Fire and reload are 0.05 s each (stock 0.5 each). The model is the mortar gun.
Part of the default spawn kit.

Mortar.summary: Sonic Mortar: the stock mortar made rapid-fire and much more lethal, with a longer flat flight.
notes: Fire time 0.03 s and reload 0.03 s (stock 2.0 and 0.5).
MortarShell damage is raised to several times an armor's health (stock 1.0), and it flies 475 before dropping (stock 275).

LaserRifle.summary: Major Laser Rifle: a rapid-fire version of the stock laser that draws only a sliver of energy per shot, so it does almost no damage.
notes: LaserRifleImage draws 0.1 to 0.2 energy per shot (stock 10 to 60) with no fire delay and a 0.05 s reload. sniperLaser keeps stock's damageConversion 0.007, so a hit does about 0.0014 damage against 1.3 health.
Still needs an Energy Pack mounted (stock LaserRifle::onUse).
Laser head hits do 30% extra.

EnergyRifle.summary: Major ELF Gun: the stock ELF beam with a lower energy threshold and a faster reload.
notes: minEnergy 0.1 (stock 3), maxEnergy 10 (stock 11), reload 0.05 s (stock 0.2). The lightningCharge beam itself is stock.

HidePack.summary: Super Teleporter: a recall pack. Activate once to save your position; activate again to snap back to it.
notes: The first activation stores your position in $HidePack::OldPos[player] ("Current Location: Saved..."). The next one zeroes your velocity, moves you there and clears the save. The pack then switches itself off.
There is no cooldown, energy cost or team restriction.

Bug: the flag check tests Player::getMountedItem's result directly, which is -1 (true) when nothing is mounted. It then passes the slot number $FlagSlot to Player::dropItem, and sends its warning to an unset %client instead of %clientId.

GhostPack.summary: Ghost Pack: a backpack that slowly repairs you while worn. Using it again "ghost shifts" you into Ghost armor with a constant shield shimmer, and a third use drops you back to Light armor.
notes: Mounting it also mounts the GhostPack2 shape in slot 7, sets auto-repair to 0.001 and shows a credits bottom-print.

Using it while mounted with ghost off: mounts GhostPack3 in slot 6, triggers the pack, swaps your armor to Ghost armor (garmor/fgarmor) keeping your energy, and stops auto-repair. Casper() then plays a shield flash on you every 0.75 s.
Ghost armor (garmor) is a copy of light armor: identical PlayerData, damage scales and item limits.
Using it again (NoGhost) always returns you to Light Armor, whatever you wore before, and sets auto-repair 0.01.
$DropFlagChance is 0, so ghosting never makes you drop the flag.

Bugs: no ItemData named GhostArmor is defined, so the GhostArmor item-count calls (which onDeactivate uses to detect ghost mode) refer to an item that does not exist. When a ghosted player dies, Casper calls Player::blowUp and Player::kill on an unset %obj.
GhostPack.source: item.cs GhostPack::onUse/onMount/onDeactivate, noghost, Casper; ArmorData.cs garmor

GhostPack2.summary: gpack: a decorative second pack shape mounted in slot 7 while the Ghost Pack is worn.
notes: Not shown in inventory. Unmounted when the Ghost Pack is deactivated.

GhostPack3.summary: A glowing pack shape mounted in slot 6 while ghost mode is on.
notes: Mounted by GhostPack::onUse when ghosting starts and unmounted by noghost. Not shown in inventory.

RepairKit.summary: Repairs almost all damage and is never used up.
notes: Unlike stock, onUse heals 0.99 (stock 0.2) and does not remove the kit.

MineAmmo.summary: Throws the stock anti-personnel mine, but mines are never used up.
notes: Unlike stock, onUse does not remove the mine, and it sets the mine to your team. onCollision still has no team check, so teammates set it off too.
0.5 s between throws.

Grenade.summary: AirBrake: instead of throwing a grenade, using one cuts your velocity to one eighth. It is never used up.
notes: Replaces stock's thrown hand grenade entirely. The VX builds use the same trick, dividing by 6.

Beacon.summary: Speed Booster: drops a Boost mine at your feet whose zero-damage blast (kickback 500) throws you. Unlimited, with no cooldown.
notes: Replaces stock's targeting beacon. onUse throws a Boost mine with zero force and sets the next allowed use to now + 0, so there is no delay between boosts.
Never used up. Boost::onDamage detonates the mine as soon as it takes any damage.
